workers.goal: Improve Zara's Prolog-first expert/runtime adapter without inventing a second registry, provider runtime, scheduler, or reasoning-mode contract. Consume the public Prolog-RLM runtime and preserve exact zero-model expert evidence.

Add Linux MPRIS/playerctl playback and now-playing context to Zara media, then make current track, artist, album, player and playback facts available for natural conversation. Keep playback effects typed and keep discussion/recommendation separate from effect authority.

Extend Zara shell with Bash-aware deterministic inspection, bash -n/shellcheck evidence, quoting and startup-file reasoning. Never source inspected shell text and never bypass zara-shell's argv/approval boundary.

Add a typed Proxmox tool surface to Zara sysadmin using the existing Dotfiles Proxmox infrastructure. Inventory/status are read-only; guest mutations require approval and fresh postcondition evidence; destructive operations are explicit-operator-only. Secrets may come only from environment, wallet/keyring, or auth-source.

Extend Zara sysadmin with Nix/NixOS/Home Manager typed checks, builds and generation reasoning. Inspection must not evaluate or build; evaluation/build/switch stay explicit capabilities with fresh verification evidence.
